S.FORM: gaga' sslalu' gaga' na sslalu' Tayal hya' ga, syun naha' glaing lalu' na laqi' hru 'buzyan naha' lalu' na yaba' naha' tay suruw, gi yasa qu blaq slpuw musa' tay yatux. nanu' iy rima' mhuqil qu yaba' na laqi' qasa ru nanak yaya' niya' qu baqun na qlqalang naha' lga, mutuw naha' s'agal lalu' na yaya' naha' 'mubuy kmayal na, aw' ga atu' na mllpuw sa kinbkaysan naha' lga, s'agal naha' lalu' na yaba' naha' lawzi gi Tayal hya' ga yaqu mlikuy qu mutuw naha' lpgun iy mllpuw sa qutux kinbkaysan laha'.
S.PHON: ɣaɣaʔ [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]laluʔ ɣaɣaʔ na [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]laluʔ tajal ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]jun naħaʔ ɣlaiŋ laluʔ na laqiʔ ħru ʔβuzjan naħaʔ laluʔ na jaβaʔ naħaʔ taj [s|ɕ]uruw ɣi ja[s|ɕ]a qu βlaq [s|ɕ]lpuw mu[s|ɕ]aʔ taj jatux nanuʔ ij rimaʔ mħuqil qu jaβaʔ na laqiʔ qa[s|ɕ]a ru nanak jajaʔ nijaʔ qu βaqun na qlqalaŋ naħaʔ lɣa mutuw naħaʔ [s|ɕ]ʔaɣal laluʔ na jajaʔ naħaʔ ʔmuβuj kmajal na awʔ ɣa atuʔ na mllpuw [s|ɕ]a kinβkaj[s|ɕ]an naħaʔ lɣa [s|ɕ]ʔaɣal naħaʔ laluʔ na jaβaʔ naħaʔ lawzi ɣi tajal ħjaʔ ɣa jaqu mlikuj qu mutuw naħaʔ lpɣun ij mllpuw [s|ɕ]a qutux kinβkaj[s|ɕ]an laħaʔ
